title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

●Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

**Company Website:**

https://aventior.com/

title: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
description:
Job Description: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
  
  
**Department:**
AI & Agent Operations (Day 2), AI Organisation
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Assistant Director, AI & Agent Operations (Singapore)
  
  
**Team Size:**
2 ML Operations Engineers
  
  
**Work Schedule:**
Rotational Shifts
  
  
**Domain:**
Information Technology (IT)
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced ML Operations Lead to manage the deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of traditional machine-learning models in production. The role will oversee predictive models across consumer, enterprise (B2B), and network businesses, including customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead a team of two engineers in India, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, governance, and operational efficiency while coordinating with the Singapore leadership team. This role focuses on classical MLOps and traditional machine-learning models, not LLMs or Generative AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and delivery timelines.
* Manage production deployment, retraining, validation, and rollback of traditional ML models using CI/CD pipelines and structured validation processes.
* Implement model monitoring to detect data, feature, and concept drift, model decay, and performance degradation; define appropriate retraining triggers and thresholds.
* Establish and maintain model registries and lineage records, including model versions, training datasets, performance baselines, and last-known-good versions.
* Ensure model changes requested by business stakeholders are implemented within agreed timelines and validated before deployment.
* Apply champion-challenger testing, backtesting, and validation gates to ensure model reliability before promoting models to production.
* Monitor model performance using appropriate metrics, including AUC, precision-recall, and other relevant evaluation measures.
* Oversee bias and fairness monitoring for decision-making models, ensuring appropriate transparency and human oversight where required.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams on data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and change notifications.
* Coordinate with the Singapore leadership team on deployment schedules, incident management, shared services, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success, operational risks, and portfolio performance against defined KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, model auditability, and applicable model-risk management requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, MLOps, or data science engineering, including team leadership.
* Hands-on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining traditional machine-learning models in production.
* Strong experience with model drift detection, retraining pipelines, model validation, and production deployment.
* Proven experience with model CI/CD, model registries, lineage management, and rollback procedures.
* Experience with champion-challenger frameworks, backtesting, and model performance evaluation.
* Strong understanding of model governance, data quality, and bias/fairness monitoring.
* Experience leading engineering teams and communicating effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with telecommunications-scale data and production ML environments.
* Prior experience managing customer churn prediction models.
* Familiarity with predictive use cases such as fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
* Experience with cloud-based machine-learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in ML/AI, Data Science, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience coordinating with international teams across geographies and time zones.

Key Competencies
  
  

* People leadership, mentoring, and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Sound operational judgment and incident management.
* Effective stakeholder communication and business requirement translation.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage production risks.
* Strong coordination skills in a cross-border reporting environment.

Decision-Making Responsibilities
  
  
**Independent Authority**

* Manage India team priorities and operational standards.
* Initiate retraining, model promotion, and rollback decisions within approved validation procedures.
* Take appropriate drift-response actions and escalate data-quality issues to Data Engineering.

**Escalation To Leadership**

* Enterprise risk acceptance and regulatory considerations.
* Cross-functional priorities and standards affecting the wider AI and data ecosystem.
* Headcount, budget, procurement, and changes impacting other platform or data functions.

Key Challenges
  
  

* Maintaining model accuracy and reliability across a diverse production portfolio.
* Managing drift, model decay, and data-quality dependencies with a lean engineering team.
* Coordinating deployments, incidents, and standards across India and Singapore.
* Balancing predictive performance with fairness, transparency, and responsible model use.

title: Senior Data Scientist – Metals Division
description:
**About TVARIT**
TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving
  
  
advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).
  
  
With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most
  
  
innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.
  
  
We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join TVARIT’s Metals Division and build AI solutions that improve quality, yield, equipment reliability, and energy efficiency in metal manufacturing plants. The role suits a hands-on data scientist who has worked with real plant data, is fluent in time-series analysis and its tooling, and brings expertise in at least one metal manufacturing domain.
  
  
You will work directly with process data from customer plants, collaborate with process engineers and plant teams to understand the physics behind the data, and take models from exploration through validation and deployment. You will also contribute to reusable models and components that scale across plants and customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Science & Modeling**

* Develop, validate, and improve ML and statistical models for Predictive Quality, Predictive Maintenance, and energy optimization use cases in metal production and processing.
* Analyze high-frequency and batch time-series data from sensors, PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, and quality labs, including alignment of process signals with quality and batch or coil/heat records.
* Engineer features that capture process behavior, such as lags, rolling statistics, frequency-domain features, process-stage segmentation, and physically meaningful derived variables.
* Apply anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, regression, and root-cause analysis techniques, and combine data-driven models with process knowledge and physics-based constraints where appropriate.
* Design robust validation strategies for time-dependent data (e.g., time-based splits, leakage checks, drift analysis) and quantify model uncertainty and limitations clearly.

**Plant & Customer Collaboration**

* Work with plant process, quality, and maintenance engineers to understand process flows, operating conditions, and failure modes, and translate them into well-defined modeling problems.
* Assess data readiness and quality at customer sites, identify gaps in instrumentation or data capture, and recommend practical remedies.
* Present findings, model results, and recommendations clearly to plant teams and customer stakeholders, linking insights to measurable outcomes such as scrap, yield, downtime, and energy consumption.

**Delivery & Productization**

* Contribute to end-to-end project delivery, from data onboarding and exploratory analysis through model deployment, monitoring, and retraining, working closely with software and data engineering teams.
* Write clean, tested, reusable Python code and contribute to shared libraries, pipelines, and model templates that can be configured across plants and customers.
* Mentor junior data scientists, review their analyses and modeling approaches, and help establish best practices for industrial data science within the division.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline; a PhD is an advantage.
* 7+ years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on experience in data science or machine learning applied to industrial or manufacturing data.
* Mandatory manufacturing plant experience: has worked on data science projects with manufacturing plants, using real process, sensor, and quality data, and working directly with plant operations or engineering teams.
* Mandatory time-series expertise: strong practical experience in time-series data analysis, including preprocessing, resampling, alignment, feature engineering, anomaly detection, forecasting, and validation of time-dependent models.
* Metal manufacturing domain expertise: in-depth knowledge of at least one metal manufacturing domain, such as steelmaking (BOF/EAF, secondary metallurgy, continuous casting), aluminum (casting, rolling, extrusion), copper, foundry/die casting, forging, rolling, or heat treatment, including the key process variables and quality drivers.
* Proven track record of taking models beyond notebooks to validated, deployed solutions that delivered measurable business impact.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical results to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

* Programming: Strong Python skills for data science, with working proficiency in SQL; good coding practices including version control (Git), modular code, and testing.
* Data analysis libraries: pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and visualization libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly, or Seaborn.
* Time-series and ML packages: Hands-on experience with packages such as statsmodels, scikit-learn, sktime, tsfresh, Darts, or Prophet, and gradient boosting libraries such as XGBoost or LightGBM.
* Deep learning: Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow for sequence models (e.g., LSTM, temporal CNN, transformer-based models) is an advantage.
* Statistics and modeling: Solid foundation in statistics, signal processing, regression, classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, and design of

experiments; familiarity with hybrid physics-informed modeling is an advantage.
  
  

* Industrial data: Familiarity with PLC/SCADA data, historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI or similar), MES, and lab/quality systems, including data quality and contextualization challenges.
* Deployment and MLOps: Understanding of model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining; experience with tools such as MLflow, Docker, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP also relevant) is an advantage

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

**Location: Pune, India (hybrid)**

**Type: Full-time**

**About Codvo.ai**

Codvo.ai is an AI-native technology services company that helps global enterprises build and scale data, cloud and AI solutions.

**Role overview**

We are hiring a Data Scientist with hands-on Predictive Intelligence Engine (PIE) experience to turn enterprise and industrial data into models that forecast outcomes and prevent failures. You will own problems end to end: framing the question, building and validating models, and putting them into production with engineering teams. * Apply statistical methods, survival analysis and experiment design to measure model impact.
* Build and evaluate GenAI / LLM solutions such as RAG pipelines where they strengthen predictive workflows.

* Strong time-series forecasting skills (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM or gradient-boosted models such as XGBoost / LightGBM).
* Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Advanced SQL and experience working with large datasets.
* Solid grounding in statistics, probability, model validation and performance metrics.

* Visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Domain exposure to Oil & Gas, Energy, LNG, Manufacturing or Healthcare / MedTech.
* Experience in a client-facing consulting or services environment.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.

Support go-to-market, and customer enablement through demos, query resolution, documentation, and training.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional and stakeholder alignment across global teams.
  
  
Mentor and develop junior product managers.
  
  
**Qualifications / Desired Experiences**
====================================
  
  
Product management and end to end delivery of products.
  
  
Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements.
  
  
Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features.
  
  
Designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer.
  
  
Excellent execution, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  
  
Good to have : AI know how, specifically experience of working on Gen AI & agentic use cases support & delivery
  
  
Payments industry experience is a plus
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!

: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

description:
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Role Purpose**
The Role will support the Global Drilling Services S&OP organization by transforming complex materials and operational data into scalable, automated, and actionable planning solutions.
  
  
The role will have a particular focus on repairable materials, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory, connecting data across operations, AMO, Manufacturing and regional organizations.
  
  
Rather than relying on manual analysis and individual material reviews, the role will develop automated data models, dashboards and analytics capable of identifying planning gaps, determining inventory requirements and supporting proactive materials decisions at global scale.
  
  
SQL, Power BI and automation will be key enablers of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop scalable analytical models and automated solutions supporting global S&OP and materials planning processes, with particular focus on repairables, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory.
* Connect and analyze data from SAP and other enterprise data sources, including material consumption, scrap, repair activity, circulation hours, installed/available asset population and inventory.
* Develop models to determine appropriate material and sub-assembly requirements based on asset population, historical consumption, utilization, repair behavior and operational demand.
* Build and maintain end-to-end Power BI solutions, including data extraction, transformation, data modeling, business logic, DAX and dashboard development.
* Use SQL to create scalable datasets and analytical models, reducing dependency on manual Excel-based analysis and repetitive data preparation.
* Develop automated planning alerts and exception-management mechanisms to identify material shortages, excess inventory, abnormal consumption, planning gaps and other conditions requiring action.
* Develop and progressively enhance predictive analytics supporting materials requirements and repairable inventory decisions.
* Maintain and improve analytical methodologies such as sub-assembly-to-asset ratios, ensuring planning parameters evolve with changes in fleet size, utilization and operational behavior.
* Improve visibility and control of capitalized inventory, supporting appropriate inventory positioning and utilization.
* Partner directly with Regional S&OP/Planning teams, AMO and Manufacturing to understand operational problems, validate assumptions and translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
* Work independently from an initially defined business problem to investigate data, identify root causes, develop potential solutions and implement sustainable tools with appropriate stakeholder guidance.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate existing manual processes across regions rather than developing isolated local solutions.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to S&OP and operational stakeholders based on the analytical models developed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to extract, combine, transform and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong Power BI capabilities, with demonstrated experience developing solutions end-to-end, including Power Query/data transformation, data modeling, DAX and visualization.
* Experience developing automated and scalable analytical solutions, replacing repetitive manual processes with sustainable data-driven workflows.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous business problem into a structured analytical approach and independently drive the solution with limited guidance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect operational behavior with materials and inventory requirements.
* Ability to work effectively across a global, cross-functional organization, interacting with regional teams, Manufacturing, AMO, S&OP and other functions.

* Experience with SAP data and materials-related processes. Deep SAP expertise is not required, but familiarity with SAP environments would be advantageous.

no compromise. **Location:** Local Pune candidates are preferred. **Work arrangement:** Work From Office is mandatory. **Shift flexibility:** Candidates must be comfortable with the specified weekday, weekend, public holiday, and rotational standby schedule. **Compensation:** ₹8–18 LPA salary budget.## Shift ScheduleAll timings below are in Singapore Time (SGT).**Weekday shifts** Shift 1: 11:30 AM–8:00 PM Shift 2: 6:00 PM–1:00 AM**Weekend and Public Holiday shifts** Shift 1: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Shift 2: 5:00 PM–1:00 AM**Rotational Standby** 1:00 AM–9:00 AMCandidates must be willing to participate in rotational shifts, weekend and public holiday coverage, and the 1:00 AM–9:00 AM standby rotation.## Interview Process Technical Interview – Round 1 Technical Interview – Round 2 Client Interview HR Discussion## Application DetailsInterested Candidates Should Share Their Updated Resume Along With Current location Total experience Relevant experience in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks Current CTC Expected CTC Official notice period and earliest possible joining date Confirmation of willingness to work from office and in rotational shiftsSkills: rest apis,python,azure databricks,azure,langgraph,langchain,docker,sql,kubernetes,communication,openai,ci/cd,git

title: Integrated Supply Chain Analyst – P3
description:
**ABOUT TENNECO**

At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best-in-class because we hustle to be better than best-in-class. Whether it’s our Core Values, radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win, or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.

How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven and focused on pushing past limits and redefining success.

Here, you’ll work alongside relentless problem-solvers committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.

Want to learn more about who we are? Check out our website to discover the Tenneco Way.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The SCM / P3 Analyst uses Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and the Microsoft Power Platform to design and maintain secure, scalable analytics and low-code solutions that support supply chain visibility, operational efficiency, workflow automation, and strategic decision-making.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Administer and support Power BI and Power Platform environments, capacities, workspaces, gateways, connections, and tenant settings.
* Design and develop Power Apps, including canvas apps and model-driven apps, for supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, quality, maintenance, and operations use cases.
* Build Power Automate cloud flows and approval workflows to streamline manual processes, notifications, exception handling, and business controls.
* Design Dataverse tables, relationships, security roles, business rules, and integrations to support scalable Power Platform solutions.
* Integrate Power Apps and Power Automate with Power BI, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Teams, SQL, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
* Package and deploy Power Platform solutions across development, test, and production environments using managed solutions, connection references, environment variables, and ALM practices.
* Apply Power Platform governance standards, including environment strategy, DLP policies, connector controls, monitoring, auditing, and Center of Excellence practices.
* Develop analytics for supply chain costs, procurement efficiency, supplier performance, inventory health, logistics, and working capital.
* Build Power BI dashboards and semantic models for demand and supply planning, inventory levels, forecast accuracy, order fulfillment, lead times, and service performance.
* Create Power Apps and Power Automate solutions to streamline purchase requests, supplier onboarding, inventory exceptions, shipment tracking, approvals, and corrective-action workflows.
* Deliver insights for supplier quality, purchase price variance, on-time delivery, order cycle time, stockouts, excess and obsolete inventory, and transportation performance.
* Integrate data from ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, procurement, and supplier systems to provide end-to-end supply chain visibility.
* Connect Power BI and Power Platform solutions to ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, procurement, Dataverse, SharePoint, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
* Ensure data consistency and accuracy across supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, and operational data sources.
* Implement row-level security (RLS), object-level security where applicable, role-based access control (RBAC), and environment-level access controls.
* Maintain audit trails, data governance policies, Power Platform governance controls, and solution documentation.
* Optimize Power BI reports, DAX calculations, and data models for faster performance.

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Market Intelligence & AI Enablement Specialist
description:
****Be part of something bigger!****
As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy.
  
  
As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!
  
  
****Purpose and Mission****
**Drive the transformation of Market Intelligence through the adoption of AI, automation and digital technologies.**
The role combines market analysis expertise with AI enablement capabilities to improve productivity, generate deeper insights, automate repetitive activities and establish next-generation market intelligence capabilities across the organisation.
  
  
****Key Activities and Responsibilities****

* Design, build, deploy, administer and continuously improve AI-powered solutions, copilots and agents that support market analysis, competitor monitoring and intelligent research workflows.
* Identify opportunities to automate data gathering, screening, synthesis, reporting and recurring market intelligence activities.
* Combine internal and external information to generate decision-ready market, customer, competitor and industry insights.
* Develop automated market monitoring, signal detection and early-warning capabilities for relevant trends, opportunities and risks.
* Partner with Commercial, IT, Data and Automation teams to convert business requirements into scalable digital solutions.
* Integrate AI-enabled insights into relevant commercial workflows, CRM environments, dashboards and reporting processes.
* Establish human-in-the-loop controls, validation routines and governance standards to support reliable and responsible use of AI-generated insights.
* Drive user adoption through practical guidance, training, documentation and change management.
* Monitor emerging AI and analytics capabilities and assess their relevance for Market Intelligence.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in Market Intelligence, Business Intelligence, Commercial Analytics, Knowledge Management, Digital Transformation or a comparable field.
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled tools, automation platforms, advanced analytics solutions or agent-based technologies.
* Experience identifying, implementing and improving digital solutions that address concrete business needs.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and supporting adoption of new tools or ways of working.

**Technical & Digital Skills**

* Practical understanding of Generative AI, prompt design, AI agents and intelligent research workflows.
* Ability to design, configure, test and continuously improve AI-enabled solutions with appropriate human oversight.
* Process automation tools such as Power Automate, RPA or comparable technologies.
* CRM and commercial systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage.
* Power BI, data visualisation and dashboard development.
* Data analytics, reporting and data management.
* Strong digital and technology curiosity, with the ability to learn emerging tools rapidly.

****Personal Competencies****

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into practical digital and AI-enabled solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills.
* Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive innovation constructively.
* Change-agent mindset with the ability to promote adoption across business functions.
* Results orientation with a strong focus on measurable business value and efficiency.
* High standards of accuracy, judgement and responsible use of information.

****Be bold and take the leap!****
We're looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!

title: Vessel Performance Expert
description:
**Job Description**
**Vessel Performance Expert**
Smart Ship Hub (SSH) is hiring a
**Vessel Performance and Machinery Condition Monitoring Expert**
in Pune: a former sailing Chief Engineer (Marine) with shore-side experience who can turn vessel data into measurable fuel, reliability and maintenance outcomes.
  
  
**Item**
**Detail**
Position
  
  
Vessel Performance Expert
  
  
Function
  
  
Vessel Performance / Fleet Intelligence
  
  
Location
  
  
Pune, India
  
  
Engagement
  
  
Full time or part time
  
  
Core expertise
  
  
Vessel Performance, Predictive Diagnostics, Predictive Maintenance, Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)
  
  
Background
  
  
Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) plus mandatory shore experience in vessel performance, Condition based monitoring, Predictive machinery health
  
  
**Purpose and Scope of the Role**
The Vessel Performance Expert is SSH’s domain authority on how ships actually run. The role links onboard engineering reality with SSH’s digital platform, so that performance insights, diagnostics and maintenance recommendations are technically credible to Chief Engineers, superintendents, ship owners & managers.
  
  
The scope covers fleet-wide monitoring of main engine, auxiliary engine, machinery performance and hull, propulsion, supports both customer-facing delivery and the product and data science teams building SSH’s analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Predictive Diagnostics**

* Detect early deviations in main engine, auxiliary engine, turbocharger, boiler and auxiliary machinery behaviour, and identify probable root causes.
* Define diagnostic rules, thresholds and fault signatures with the data science team; validate model alerts against engineering judgement.

**Predictive Maintenance**

* Translate diagnostic findings into maintenance recommendations, spares planning and risk-ranked work orders.
* Align recommendations with PMS, class requirements and OEM guidelines; track outcomes to improve model accuracy.

**Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)**

* Design and maintain CBM programmes covering vibration, lube oil analysis, exhaust gas temperatures, cylinder pressures and bearing temperatures.
* Define sensor and data requirements for new vessels and retrofits; review data quality and flag gaps.

**Vessel Performance**

* Analyse speed, fuel consumption, trim, draft, hull and propeller condition, and weather-corrected performance using noon, high-frequency sensor and voyage data.
* Benchmark vessels and sister ships; recommend operational and technical actions that cut fuel cost and emissions (CII, EEOI, EU ETS exposure).
* Quantify hull cleaning, dry-dock and retrofit impact; produce performance reports for owners, managers and charterers.

**Customer and Internal Collaboration**

* Act as technical interface with customers’ superintendents and Chief Engineers; support presales demos and onboarding.
* Provide domain input to Product and Engineering for features, dashboards and alert logic.
* Mentor junior analysts on marine engineering concepts.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
**Mandatory**

* Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) on ocean-going vessels; valid CoC Class I (Motor/Steam) or equivalent.
* Shore-side experience in vessel performance is a must (for example in vessel or fleet performance management, performance analytics or technical superintendency with a performance focus).
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in vessel performance, condition based monitoring, predictive diagnostics and predictive maintenance.
* Degree in Marine or Mechanical Engineering.

**Preferred**

* Experience with performance or CBM platforms, noon-report and high-frequency data, and OEM monitoring systems.
* Working knowledge of IMO CII, SEEMP, EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime.
* Exposure to Python, SQL or BI tools for analysis.
* Experience working with data science or product teams or customer-facing exposure.

**Deliverables, Engagement Terms and Why SSH**
**Key deliverables and KPIs**

* Monthly fleet performance and CBM reports delivered on time.
* Diagnostic alerts validated with a documented root cause and recommended action.
* Maintenance recommendations accepted and closed by customers; targets to be agreed with the hiring manager.
* Documented diagnostic rules and CBM playbooks added to SSH’s knowledge base.

**Why join Smart Ship Hub**

* Apply sea-going experience to a global maritime digital platform.
* Shape predictive analytics products used by ship owners and managers.
* Work directly with leadership in a growth-stage environment.

*Smart Ship Hub is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates all candidates on skills and experience.*

description:
Your role
  
  
**Mission**
As a Diagnostics Engineer, you will redefine the future of turbo compressor & expander (from GAP division) maintenance by harnessing the power of IoT, AI, and advanced diagnostics. Leveraging data from SMARTLINK IoT technology, you’ll remotely analyze machine performance, anticipate issues, and deliver insights that drive reliability, efficiency, and cost optimization. Your expertise will empower GAP product companies / customer centers globally to achieve unparalleled operational excellence.
  
  
**Roles**
**What You’ll Do, short- and mid-term**

* Data-Driven Analysis:

+ Conduct detailed operation data analysis of IoT data uploads to ensure compressor & expander systems performance and uptime.
+ Drive improvements opportunities in safety, reliability, and productivity for customer installations.

* Technical Support & Troubleshooting:

+ Offer proactive remote support for reporting and analyses.
+ Deliver clear and actionable recommendations for corrective and preventive maintenance, following GAP maintenance intervals.
+ Global Collaboration:

+ Work closely with technical and engineering teams in product company AC-Energas in Cologne and/or Divisional development team.
+ Provide input to enhance IoT platform logic and algorithms, shaping the next generation of diagnostics.
+ Continuous Improvement:

+ Follow up on recommended solutions to ensure effectiveness.
+ Gather field feedback to refine diagnostic tools and processes, driving higher system accuracy and efficiency.

**What You’ll Do, Long-term**

* Algorithm Development & Validation:

+ Contribute to the design, validation, and execution of advanced predictive and prescriptive maintenance algorithms for compressors & expanders.
+ Help evolve diagnostic intelligence to predict potential failures and optimize uptime.
+ Shift-Based Support:

+ This role follows a structured shift schedule, planned to ensure 24×7 diagnostic support.
+ You will be part of a dedicated team committed to delivering uninterrupted technical expertise and timely responses within the scope of diagnostic service.

To succeed, you will need
  
  
**What You Bring**

* Education & Experience:

+ Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or mechatronics engineering.
+ At least 2 years of hands-on experience in troubleshooting and engineering compressors or similar equipment.
+ Knowledge of compressor room setups, including oil-free and oil-injected screw compressors, centrifugal compressors, and related equipment (e.g., dryers and vacuum pumps).

* Technical Expertise:

+ Strong understanding of the Atlas Copco Compressor Technique equipment portfolio, in best case even GAP product portfolio.
+ Nice to have: Familiarity with compressor control systems, airflow dynamics, and heat transfer principles.

* Analytical Mindset:

+ Proficient in analysing IoT data streams, trend graphs, and historical records to make sound technical decisions.
+ Experience in using diagnostic tools and combining multiple data points for actionable insights.

* Tech-Savvy:

+ Knowledge of cloud-based IoT platforms, prescriptive maintenance software, and ERP systems.
+ Experience with data visualization tools, AI-powered analytics, and connected system diagnostics.

**Who You Are**

* Curious Innovator: You embrace new challenges and love finding innovative solutions.
* Global Collaborator: You thrive in a multicultural environment and enjoy working with diverse teams.
* Decisive Thinker: You make decisions confidently, learn from feedback, and improve continuously.
* Structured Professional: You excel in organizing, analysing, and presenting data to build effective diagnostic solutions.
* Strong Communicator: You articulate technical insights clearly and effectively across various stakeholders.

In return, we offer
  
  

* A work culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behavior, and integrity.
* Access to Global Job Opportunities as a part of the Atlas Copco Group
* Opportunities to grow and develop yourself in the connected world.
* Potential to see your ideas realized and to make an impact.
* New challenges and new learnings on the global organization matrix

Job location
  
  
Hybrid
  
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Pune.
  
  
Contact information
  
  
**Uniting curious minds**
Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
