title: Team Lead - AI & Data Science
description:
**Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science**

**Required Experience:**
5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimization while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5.Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied

 AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

●Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

title: ML Operations Lead
description:
# Job Title: ML Operations Lead
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 18–25 Years overall
* Relevant Experience:\*\* 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadership
* Location:\*\* Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune
* Work Mode:\*\* 5 Days Work from Office
* Working Hours:\*\* 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)

## Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.
  
  
The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.
  
  

* Note:\*\* This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.

## Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices.
* Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production.
* Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production.
* Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required.
* Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio.
* Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability.
* Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records.
* Track model performance using relevant metrics such as AUC, precision, recall, and other business-aligned KPIs.
* Monitor model bias and fairness, ensuring appropriate controls and human oversight for sensitive decision-making use cases.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to manage data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and upstream data changes.
* Implement business-requested model changes within agreed timelines while maintaining operational and validation standards.
* Coordinate with international stakeholders on deployment schedules, production incidents, change management, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success rates, retraining outcomes, and overall portfolio performance.
* Support predictive ML use cases such as customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.

##
**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong experience in \*\*MLOps and production ML operations\*\*.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating traditional Machine Learning models in production.
* Strong understanding of \*\*customer churn prediction models\*\* and related predictive analytics use cases.
* Expertise in model deployment, model monitoring, drift detection, and model retraining.
* Experience implementing ML CI/CD pipelines, model registries, and model lineage.
* Practical experience with data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model decay management.
* Experience with model validation, backtesting, and champion-challenger methodologies.
* Knowledge of model performance metrics, including AUC, precision, recall, and precision-recall evaluation.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and managing operational priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including cross-border collaboration.
* Ability to translate business requirements into operational priorities and deliver model changes within agreed timelines.
* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience in telecommunications (telco) or large-scale data environments.
* Exposure to fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting models.
* Experience with cloud-based Machine Learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with model governance, auditability, responsible AI, bias monitoring, and model-risk management.

## Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Ability to lead a lean ML Operations team and establish scalable operating practices.
* Strong operational judgment and ownership of production model health.
* Effective coordination with business, data, and platform stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Minimum 2 years of stability in an organization.
* Immediate joiners and candidates currently serving notice are preferred.
* Candidates based in Pune are preferred.
* Willingness to work from the office five days a week in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune.
* Excellent communication skills are essential due to regular stakeholder and client interaction.

## Interview Process
  
  

* 2 Technical Rounds
* 1 Client Round
* HR Round

Skills: feature drift,model deployment,drift detection,metrics,auc,machine learning models,model monitoring,model validation,mlops,production ml operations,backtesting,ml ci/cd pipelines,model registries,stakeholder-management,concept drift,data drift,customer churn prediction models

**Architecture & Design**

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant batch and real-time data processing pipelines.
* Develop robust data models and schema designs optimized for both performance and storage efficiency.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging tools and frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka) into the existing stack.
* Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals

**Data Modernization & Migration Leadership**

* Optimize complex SQL queries and fine-tune distributed computing clusters to reduce latency and costs.

* DevOps & Reliability

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Highly experienced and skilled technical lead with 12+years of experience with software building and platform engineering.

* Knowledge in Hadoop, YARN, Hive, Impala, Spark, and Spark SQL with extensive high volume of data processing pipeline development. Programming Expert level and hand on experience in Python.

* Hands-on experience in writing SQL queries.
* Highly experienced with Unix based operating systems and shell scripting.
* Experience with source code management tools such as Bitbucket, Git etc.
* Big Data Tech Proficiency and hands-on in Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka, and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, HBase).
* Experience working with query engines like Trino, Presto, Starburst

* Data Lineage, Experience using tools (like Collibra or Informatica) to track where data comes from and where it’s going.
* Change Management, Experience managing the technical "shock" to the business when switching from legacy BI tools to modern query engines like Starburst.

* Communicator: You can explain the "why" behind a technical decision to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Global REFM Governance & Performance Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you: innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.
  
  
**About You**
In this role, you will deliver recurring governance processes, prepare data-driven performance insights, manage action plans, and help identify and implement risk countermeasures, savings, cost avoidance, operational excellence, and process improvements. You will also support supplier migrations, contract lifecycle activities, and continuous improvement while partnering with REFM Global Process Owners, global and regional stakeholders, suppliers, Procurement, Finance, and other teams. It starts with YOU.
  
  
The Supplier Governance Analyst drives supplier governance, KPI performance, and financial tracking for Global Business Services Real Estate and Facilities Management (GBS REFM).
  
  
**Job Responsibilities Include**
Supplier Governance & Performance Management
  
  

* Drive recurring supplier governance routines, including monthly reviews, quarterly business reviews, KPI scorecards, action logs, issue escalation, and performance tracking.

Financial, Contract & Risk Management

* Maintain trackers, governance artifacts, performance summaries, and supporting documentation.
* Apply a progress-over-perfection mindset while maintaining accountability, quality, and momentum.

Stakeholder & Supplier Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with REFM Global Process Owners and global and regional stakeholders to support disciplined supplier service delivery.

* Communicate complex performance, financial, contract, and operational information clearly across diverse stakeholder levels.

Analytics & Reporting
  
  

* Use Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and related tools for data validation, trackers, analysis, performance summaries, and executive-ready reporting.
* Translate complex data into clear insights, risks, actions, and decision points.

* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Facilities Management, Engineering, Procurement, or a related field is preferred.

* Experience coordinating diverse stakeholders and suppliers in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required and work across time zones, including flexible hours in a global role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IFMA Certified Facility Manager (CFM), Facility Management Professional (FMP), or equivalent certification.

Leadership Behaviors & Core Capabilities
  
  

* Demonstrates Care, Own, Act.
* Collaboration and accountability.
* Bias for action and progress over perfection.

title: BC Sector O and G-Data Scientist-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST**
**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**
**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level 15+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Participate in a range of Support initiatives
* Provide support coverage during holidays and weekends based on business needs

* 2+ years of experience in a technical support environment or a similar technical, customer-facing function
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail
* In-depth knowledge of at least one major cloud provider's ecosystem
* Working knowledge of Python and relevant ML libraries
* An intermediate understanding of LLMs and their enterprise applications
* Understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in a 24x7 support environment, including technical case escalation, incident management, and on-call rotations
* Background supporting an RDBMS, and familiarity with database release management
* Understanding of machine learning foundations — neural networks, statistics, and optimisation — and of optimising model performance, scalability, and efficiency
* Production experience with frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras

* Experience with API tooling such as Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, and API Gateway
* Experience with data visualisation tools — Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly

The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
* Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
* Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
**In a nutshell**

Loylogic created the global rewards marketplace. Today, we are leading its evolution into the AI era - helping organizations recognize, reward and incentivize their most valuable customers, employees and partners with greater intelligence, relevance and impact.

Loylogic is looking for a highly hands-on AI Transformation Lead to help redesign how work gets done across our company. This is not primarily an AI strategy, research or advisory role. We are looking for a builder with a strong business and process mindset: someone who can quickly understand how work happens today, challenge it, simplify it and then use AI agents, automation and modern technology to make the better way of working a reality.

Working directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, you will have the opportunity to work horizontally across the organisation: Commercial - Sales, RevOps, Customer Success; Marketplace – Partnerships, Marketplace – Performance, Platform, and Corporate (Finance, PE, Legal). Our ambition is not to deploy AI for the sake of AI.

It is to make Loylogic a genuinely AI-native company and materially improve how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission can be summarized in five words:

DISCOVER → CHALLENGE → BUILD → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE

* Discover — Get close to our teams and rapidly understand how our most important work actually gets done.
* Challenge — Identify unnecessary work, bottlenecks and complexity. Determine what can be stopped, simplified, automated or fundamentally redesigned.
* Build — Personally prototype AI agents, automations and AI-enabled workflows rather than simply recommending what somebody else should build.
* Implement — Work with our functional teams and Technology to turn successful prototypes into solutions that become part of everyday work.
* Measure — Demonstrate what changed: capacity created, cycle times reduced, quality improved, revenue opportunities enabled, costs avoided and other measurable business outcomes.

***How we think about AI and work***

We don’t assume that every problem needs an AI agent.

Before automating an existing process, we want to understand whether that process should exist in its current form at all.

For the processes you work on, we expect you to think along the lines of:

STOP → SIMPLIFY → AUTOMATE/AGENT → BOOST

* Stop: Does this activity actually need to be done?
* Simplify: Can we make the process fundamentally simpler?
* Automate/Agent: Which activities can AI agents or conventional automation perform reliably?
* BOOST: Where should the person keep the work, with AI making them faster, sharper or better informed?
* Where these changes create meaningful additional capacity, you will help quantify that opportunity so functional leadership can determine how it can best be redirected towards higher-value work.

**What you will do**

You will:

* Rapidly map and understand critical workflows across Loylogic.
* Work directly with functional leaders and the people performing the work.
* Identify and prioritise the highest-value AI and process-transformation opportunities.
* Challenge existing processes before automating them.
* Identify activities that can be eliminated, simplified, automated or AI-augmented.
* Personally prototype and build AI agents, automations and internal tools.
* Integrate solutions with existing systems, data and APIs where appropriate.
* Design appropriate human oversight and escalation into AI-enabled workflows.
* Work closely with Technology to move successful prototypes into secure, reliable and scalable production environments.
* Create reusable components and approaches rather than solving every problem from scratch.
* Help teams adopt new workflows and ways of working.
* Measure the impact of implemented solutions.
* Quantify capacity released and identify opportunities for higher-value use of that capacity.
* Maintain a prioritised pipeline of further transformation opportunities.
* Stay close to developments in agentic AI and rapidly experiment with relevant new capabilities.
* We expect you to build, not just recommend.

***What this could look like in practice***

* You might redesign an RFP process so AI handles research, knowledge retrieval and first-draft creation, allowing Sales to spend more time developing the proposition and engaging the client.
* You could reduce the time Customer Success Managers spend preparing client reporting and QBRs, creating additional capacity for performance analysis, upselling and proactive client engagement.
* You might automate elements of supplier onboarding, catalogue enrichment, management reporting, CRM administration, reconciliation, contract analysis or internal knowledge retrieval.
* Sometimes the right answer will be an AI agent.
* Sometimes it will be conventional automation.
* Sometimes it will simply be a much better process.
* And sometimes the answer will be that a human should continue doing the work — but with much better AI support.
* We expect you to understand the difference.

**What you will do**

We are deliberately not looking for an “AI guru.”

We want an energetic, curious, pragmatic and exceptionally resourceful person who enjoys understanding problems, building solutions and getting them into everyday use.

You will probably have around 2–7 years of relevant professional experience, although demonstrated ability matters considerably more to us than years of experience.

***You should bring a combination of:***

* Strong business-process and problem-solving skills.
* Practical experience applying generative AI and LLMs to real business problems.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents and automated workflows.
* Ability to work with APIs, structured data and business systems.
* Working knowledge of Python or comparable scripting/development capabilities.
* Experience with modern automation/orchestration platforms and AI development tools.
* Understanding of RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompting and agentic architectures.
* An understanding of when human oversight is required in AI-enabled workflows.
* Enough technical depth to build independently while recognizing when enterprise engineering support is required.
* Strong commercial judgement and an ability to prioritize according to business value.
* Excellent communication skills and an ability to understand unfamiliar business areas quickly.
* A strong bias towards experimentation, prototyping and shipping.
* Experience in loyalty is not required. Experience in a fast-moving technology company, SaaS business, marketplace, fintech, scale-up, AI company or entrepreneurial environment would be particularly relevant.

***How you think***

When someone explains a complicated process, your instinct is to ask: “Can you show me how you actually do this today?”

* You don’t automatically assume AI is the answer.
* You first understand the problem, challenge the process and determine the best way of doing the work. Then you build.
* You are equally comfortable discussing a business problem with the CEO or COO, sitting with someone in Finance to understand a reconciliation process, or spending the afternoon building and testing an agent yourself.
* You like autonomy, speed and accountability.

***What this role is not***

This is not a Chief AI Officer role.

* It is not primarily about producing AI strategies, PowerPoint presentations, running innovation workshops or managing large transformation programs.
* Nor is success measured by how many AI agents we deploy.
* This is a hands-on role focused on redesigning work and delivering measurable business outcomes, using AI and automation wherever they are the best tools for the job.

***What success looks like***

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to have developed a practical understanding of the highest-value transformation opportunities across Loylogic, created a prioritized pipeline, redesigned several meaningful workflows and already built and deployed the first AI-enabled solutions.

From there, we will measure success through tangible outcomes including:

* Productivity gained • cycle times reduced • quality improved • commercial capacity created • scalability increased • costs avoided or reduced • employee adoption • measurable revenue opportunities enabled
* Ultimately, we want to combine great people, better processes and increasingly capable AI so that Loylogic can achieve materially more with the organization we have.

**What we offer**

Loylogic is an international business with colleagues, clients and partners located across the world. We combine global scale with an entrepreneurial culture in which people are encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge established thinking and take ownership of meaningful outcomes.

You will join a business shaping the future of AI-powered rewards and engagement, working with recognized global brands and sophisticated loyalty programs across multiple industries and markets. Our goodies for you

Our benefits include:

* Highly-attractive bonus scheme
* Competitive salary dependent on experience
* Hybrid working model (mix of office and home office)
* Own points-based incentive program

And many more benefits.

People Systems & HRIS

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Role –**
The VMC FP&A Analyst reports to the BU FP&A VMC Team Lead and works closely with the BU Head, BU FP&A, R2R, Costing Analyst, IBP, ISC and Commercial Navigators / Controller, creating an impact by providing high value adding analysis on variable manufacturing cost (VMC) of the respective BU at various levels (BU, Performance Cell, Region, Country, Legal Entity, Site, Customer-Material to the ISC and Commercial association.
  
  
**VMC CoE End to End Scope:**
The VMC CoE Analyst collaborates with BU finance leadership to provide a detailed overview of VMC development, using advanced data platforms like CFIN, CRYSTAL, Power BI, Alteryx, and SAP BI. They identify cost variance drivers, conduct root cause analysis, and work with other pillars to implement corrective actions. The Analyst also supports future cost planning for critical pricing decisions.
  
  
As a reliable business partner, the Analyst identifies and flags process and system related issues, ensuring adherence to accounting standards and AkzoNobel’s P&L guidance (PLENT). They contribute to key projects and continuously improve processes through CI initiatives.
  
  
Candidates should be open to learning new skills and flexible in exploring new ways of working. AkzoNobel promotes a dynamic work culture with a focus on technology adoption to stay ahead of the curve. Analysts are expected to prioritize skill development to keep pace with market and competitor advancements, such as AI and Automation.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Planning (QRF + Budget):
* Budget Preparation: Prepare budget templates, gather inputs, and load FLM data; run validation checks and resolve data issues.
* Rolling Forecast: Update drivers and post approved manual adjustments; ensure documentation and version control.
* Forecast Translation: Upload and reconcile forecast data in HFM; resolve validation errors under guidance.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Collect inputs from Demand, Data Science, Costing, and Procurement FP&A; track submissions to closure.
* Cost Trend Packs: Generate cost-trend reports vs PY/BUD/QRF; prepare variance tables and initial commentary.
* VMC Bridge Build: Consolidate inputs for PVM bridge and co-ordinate with HRT; validate mappings and ensure consistency with prior versions.
* Strategic Business Support:
* Variance Packs: Prepare MEC variance packs and waterfall charts; summarize drivers for review.
* A06 Preparation: Populate A06 templates; compare to prior periods and fix mapping issues.
* KPI Dashboard: Refresh KPI dashboards (VMC, VMC/L); run data-quality checks and highlight outliers.
* PVM Observations: Draft observations from PVM results for VMC Story telling.
* IBP Support: Compile IBP materials, update slides, record minutes and action owners
* Inventory Revaluation: Calculate RMPI-based forecast impact; maintain workings and assumptions repository.
* Data & Process Integrity (System hygiene, process hygiene):
* Data Hygiene Monitoring: Run exception/integrity reports; flag anomalies (e.g., not-in-use materials) to owners.
* RCA Support: Provide data extracts and trend summaries for RCAs; track action status.
* Gap Ticketing: Raise system/process gap tickets and follow up to resolution.
* Process Improvements:
* Product Cost Checks: Validate BOM/routing and cost splits; flag anomalies to costing.
* CI & Automation: Build macros/Power Query/Power BI measures; document steps and handover notes.
* System Reconciliations: Execute reconciliation scripts across HFM/CFIN/Crystal/SAP; log and categorize issues.
* Digital Tool Usage: Adopt approved AI/digital tools; provide structured feedback.
* Data Standards: Apply naming conventions and data definitions consistently.
* Project Support:
* Project Documentation: Maintain project trackers, timelines, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependency) logs for assigned initiatives.
* Data Provisioning: Extract, cleanse, and provision datasets for project charters and ad hoc analyses.

**Education**

* Proven work experience “5 to 7 years” in a strategic financial analysis role is essential.
* Qualified chartered or cost accountant or similar equivalent professional competency.
* Experience in large scale manufacturing industry/GBS/GCC. Leveraging deep industry knowledge to enhance financial analysis, cost management, and strategic planning.
* Focus on stakeholder management (e.g. BU Head of Finance, Head of FP&A, Reg Proc Director, Comm, ISC Navigators, Acc Controller, R2R, etc.) engaging to drive actions that support strategic objectives.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting, optimize data processes, and provide strategic insights to support high-level decision-making (VMC FP&A team is collectively analyzing Variable Manufacturing Cost of around 6 billion €, BU wise ranging from 0.3 billion € to 1 billion €).
* In-depth knowledge of process order settlement and material ledger runs, familiarity with Inter Company (ICD) transactions, proficiency in managing material master attributes, strong analytical skills for financial reviews, and effective communication skills for managing price variations and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Possess in-depth knowledge of Financial & Cost accounting, Product costing, Transfer pricing, IFRS, Financial Statements, and System accounting flow, with a dynamic and innovative approach to problem-solving.
* Must have experience in a multinational company, demonstrating a proven track record of success. Ability to think outside the box and drive strategic financial initiatives.
* Support in managing external financial reporting & ensuring compliance. Responsibilities include preparing VMC Price Volume Mix reporting and Analysis “A06”.
* Proven experience in managing complex organizational setups. Responsibilities include overseeing intricate financial structures, ensuring seamless integration of financial systems, and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

years of coding experience in above languages,

This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.

* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics
* Regulatory knowledge in FRTB Basel, CCAR
* Professional certifications (CQF, FRM, PRM, RAI are a plus)

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Machine Learning / Data Scientist, Consultant
  
  
Deloitte Consulting LLP | IDT
  
  
**About The Role**
At Deloitte Consulting LLP, Data Scientists and ML Engineers leverage advanced analytics and machine learning to transform data into actionable business insights and innovative solutions. Our teams foster technical excellence, real-world impact, and professional growth for every team member. This is a Consultant-level role based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.
  
  
IDT anticipates how technology will shape the future and begins building future capabilities and practices today, driving the ideation, incubation, and scale of hybrid businesses and tech-enabled offerings. Partnering with the broader network — including Converge, Smart Factory, TrueServe, and Cortex AI — IDT brings together dreamers, designers, and builders to deliver a unique point of view and future-proof both Deloitte's business and its clients'.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Build & Deploy ML Solutions
  
  

* Lead the design and deployment of advanced, scalable ML solutions for enterprise use cases
* Oversee data ingestion, wrangling, and processing at scale using appropriate big data tools
* Architect, develop, and optimize APIs for robust ML model serving in production environments

MLOps & Production Engineering
  
  

* Utilize MLflow for experiment tracking, reproducibility, and lifecycle management
* Drive cloud-native deployment, monitoring, and automation for ML solutions

Communicate & Grow
  
  

* Mentor consultants, guide technical reviews, and promote best practices in software engineering and MLOps
* Communicate complex insights to stakeholders and ensure alignment with client objectives
* Keep current with AI/ML advancements and lead knowledge-sharing within project teams

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT. Collaborates with project stakeholders and may mentor junior consultants on a need basis.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 2-5 years of experience developing, deploying, and interpreting machine learning solutions in business or technical environments
* Demonstrated experience with core statistical and ML algorithms, including linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, clustering, dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA), and time series analysis and forecasting
* Hands-on experience using Python for data preparation, wrangling (cleaning, feature engineering), and model development
* Proven ability to work with large datasets using Pandas, NumPy, SQL, or PySpark
* Experience implementing models with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras)
* Solid experience in data visualization using Python libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn) or business visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI)
* Practical experience creating and serving Python-based APIs using frameworks like FastAPI or Flask
* Ability to code, evaluate, and deploy basic ML models within data pipelines
* Experience working on projects within cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is preferred
* Strong analytical, teamwork, and communication skills
* B.E./B.Tech./M.C.A./M.Sc./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline

**Preferred**

* Experience with large-scale data processing platforms (PySpark, Dask, BigQuery, Databricks)
* Advanced cloud-based data tool knowledge and ML deployment skills
* Familiarity with productivity tools like GitHub Copilot or AWS CodeWhisperer
* Understanding of industry trends in ML, AI, and MLOps

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong ML engineering and experimentation craft (Python, MLflow)
* Ability to translate ML solutions into production-ready APIs
* Cloud-native deployment and automation mindset
* Clear communicator of complex analytical insights
* Mentor and promoter of engineering/MLOps best practices
* Curious and current on AI/ML advancements

Why This Role Matters
  
  
A machine learning model only creates value once it's built well, shipped reliably, and trusted by the business that uses it. This role owns that full journey — turning data into actionable insight, and insight into production-grade solutions clients can build decisions on.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Dear Candidate,

**Greetings from AkzoNobel (Experts in the proud craft of making paints and coatings since 1792)**

We are hiring for the role of Data Scientist at Pune (Hybrid role), below are additional details as required.

**No of Positions - 5**

**Position No 1 (2 roles) - Skills - Data Science & ML Concepts, Statistical libraries, Python, SQL, Deployments & Azure etc.**

**Position No 2 (2 roles) - Skills - Descriptive & Prescriptive Analytics, Datalake & Synapse, Data Science & ML Concepts, Statistical libraries, Python, SQL, Deployments & Azure etc.**

**Position No 3 (1 role) - Skills - Pyspark, Creating Notebooks (Python & SQL), Databricks Dashboarding, DBK Genie, Data Science & ML Concepts, Statistical libraries, Python, SQL, Deployments & Azure etc.**

**Overview**

You will join the AkzoNobels Advanced Analytics team, working at the heart of a global manufacturing environment. Your mission: accelerate world-class end-to-end supply chain performance by delivering scalable, secure, and high-impact AI/data products on our Azure cloud platform.

Youll collaborate with supply chain leaders (MAKE, SOURCE, DELIVER, QUALITY, PLAN, IBP), IT, engineering, and external software partners. You will operate in a product mindsetturning business needs into AI-enabled capabilities that are reliable in production, measurable in value, and continuously improved.

**Job Purpose**

On a global scale, you will co-deliver AI and analytics solutions that improve \*\*service, cost, inventory, and planning stability\*\*, including:

* E2E Reporting & Decision Intelligence\*\*

Modern analytics and KPI frameworks across Integrated Supply Chain (MAKE, SOURCE, DELIVER, QUALITY, PLAN & IBP), enabling faster and better decisions.

* Master Data Quality & Automation\*\*

Improve and govern master data (lifecycle statuses, MRP parameters, routings, capacity, production data capture) to stabilize planning and execution.

* Predictive, Prescriptive & Optimization Models\*\*

Build and deploy models on big-data platforms to optimize MRP and network design, such as demand segmentation (ABC/XYZ), supply policies (MTO/MTS), lot sizing, safety stock placement/levels, and capacity-aware planning.

* Automation for IBP & Financial Planning\*\*

Deliver robust, auditable and scalable global solutions for planning processes with a strong focus on automation, reliability, adoption, and sustainable performance.

* AI Enablement & Responsible AI\*\*

Introduce and scale AI capabilities (ML, optimization, and GenAI where valuable) with clear governance, model risk management, and ethical/secure implementation.

**Role & Responsibilities**

You will contribute as \*\*Data Scientist + AI Product Owner\*\* in an Agile/DevOps setup.

1. Data Science & Applied AI

- Design, train, evaluate, and deploy \*\*machine learning, statistical, and optimization\*\* solutions for forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and decision recommendations.

- Apply best practices for \*\*feature engineering, model validation, uncertainty quantification\*\*, and error metrics aligned with supply chain decisions.

- Translate business questions into testable hypotheses and measurable model outcomes (e.g., service level impact, inventory reduction, stability improvements).

2. AI Product Ownership (end-to-end)

- Define product vision, value proposition, roadmap, and success metrics for AI/data products.- Manage and prioritize the backlog (epics/user stories), align stakeholders, and drive iterative delivery.

- Ensure adoption: design for user workflows, change management, and training materials.

- Drive continuous improvement based on feedback, performance monitoring, and business results

3. Data Engineering & Platform Collaboration

- Work hands-on with data pipelines: extract, cleanse, standardize, validate and document data.

- Partner closely with Data Engineers/Architects to build robust data products (quality checks, lineage, access controls, reusability).

- Contribute to scalable patterns for batch/stream processing (where relevant) within Azure.

4. MLOps / LLMOps / Production Reliability

- Operationalize models with CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and drift detection.

- Establish model lifecycle practices: versioning, retraining triggers, model registry, and reproducible pipelines.

- For GenAI use cases: implement \*\*skills/prompt/version management\*\*, evaluation, guardrails, and secure integration (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation for supply chain knowledge).

5. Data Analytics, Reporting & Storytelling

- Build decision-grade dashboards and semantic layers for multi-stakeholder reporting (Power BI or similar).

- Communicate findings clearly to business and technical audiences; create functional/technical documentation.

6. Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions comply with data privacy, security standards, and Responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, traceability, auditability).

- Define and track \*\*model KPIs\*\* (accuracy, stability, bias checks, latency, uptime, business outcome metrics).

**Regards,**

**Team AkzoNobel**

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**At Global IT Hub, we are more than a technology organization. We are a community of innovators, problem-solvers, and digital pioneers dedicated to accelerating Atlas Copco Group’s business potential through world-class technology solutions. Join us to shape the future of digital transformation, work on global challenges, and create impact for businesses and customers worldwide.**
**CLASSICAL MACHINE LEARNING | JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Role purpose**
Lead the design, validation, deployment and lifecycle ownership of production-grade classical machine learning solutions that convert business problems into measurable outcomes. The role combines deep algorithmic expertise, disciplined CRISP-DM execution, MLOps practices and senior technical leadership.
  
  
Role at a glance
  
  
**Team**
AI Team, Global IT Hub
  
  
**Primary Stakeholders**
Business product owners, IT, data engineering, analytics and domain teams
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years in data science / machine learning, including 3+ years owning production ML solutions
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with stakeholders to frame ambiguous business needs as well-defined machine learning problems, including decision context, baselines, constraints, risks and measurable success criteria.
* Lead end-to-end delivery using CRISP-DM: business understanding, data understanding, data preparation, modeling, evaluation and deployment, with iteration and traceability across phases.
* Design, train and compare classical supervised and unsupervised learning models; select the simplest approach that meets performance, interpretability, latency, scalability and cost requirements.
* Own feature engineering, data leakage prevention, sampling strategy, cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, threshold selection, calibration and robust error analysis.
* Build reliable evaluation frameworks using fit-for-purpose metrics, statistical tests, confidence intervals, business-cost functions and champion-challenger comparisons.
* Take models from experimentation to production with engineering teams, covering packaging, APIs or batch scoring, versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, retraining and rollback.
* Own post-production performance, including drift detection, data-quality controls, incident analysis, model refresh decisions and communication of model limitations.
* Apply explainability and responsible AI practices through model cards, reproducibility, bias and fairness checks, audit trails, privacy-aware design and human oversight.
* Set technical standards, conduct design and code reviews, mentor data scientists, create reusable components and influence the classical ML roadmap.
* Communicate recommendations, uncertainty, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, business leaders and governance forums.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced Python and SQL, with strong hands-on use of NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, SciPy and statsmodels; ability to write modular, tested and maintainable code.
* Deep knowledge of regression and classification: linear and logistic regression, regularization, decision trees, Random Forest, Extra Trees, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, support vector machines, k-nearest neighbors, Naive Bayes and appropriate ensemble methods.
* Strong understanding of unsupervised learning: k-means and hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, PCA and other dimensionality-reduction methods, anomaly or outlier detection and segmentation evaluation.
* Practical knowledge of forecasting and statistical modeling, including ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, trend and seasonality, lag features, back-testing and prediction intervals.
* Expertise in feature selection and engineering, missing-value treatment, categorical encoding, class imbalance, resampling, pipeline design and prevention of target leakage.
* Rigorous evaluation skills across ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, log loss, RMSE, MAE, MAPE/WAPE, lift, gain, calibration and business-impact metrics, selected according to the use case.
* Hands-on optimization using grid, random or Bayesian search, with sound cross-validation design for grouped, temporal and imbalanced datasets.
* Practical MLOps experience with experiment tracking, model registry, source control, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, deployment and model or data monitoring.
* Working knowledge of explainability techniques such as feature importance, permutation importance, partial dependence and SHAP, including their limitations.
* Experience handling large structured datasets and collaborating on scalable data pipelines in a cloud or distributed environment.

Senior-level capabilities
  
  

* Independently owns technical direction and delivery for complex ML use cases from discovery through production adoption.
* Challenges weak problem formulations and prevents unnecessary use of ML when rules, analytics or simpler statistical methods are more suitable.
* Makes defensible trade-offs among accuracy, interpretability, maintainability, latency and cost.
* Reviews experimental design and model evidence before approving production release.
* Mentors team members and raises standards for coding, documentation, reproducibility and stakeholder communication.

Good-to-have experience
  
  

* Domain exposure in manufacturing, industrial operations, supply chain, service, pricing, finance, sales or customer analytics.
* Optimization, causal inference, survival analysis, uplift modeling, recommendation systems, geospatial analytics or graph-based techniques.
* Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, MLflow, Spark and enterprise data sources such as SAP.
* Experience integrating classical ML models into applications, APIs, decision-support workflows or Power BI solutions.
* Awareness of deep learning and generative AI, with the judgment to benchmark them against classical ML rather than defaulting to higher-complexity approaches.

Core algorithm and method coverage
  
  
Candidates are expected to demonstrate depth in several categories and sound model-selection judgment across the full landscape. This is not a requirement to have used every library or algorithm in production.
  
  
**Capability area**
**Expected knowledge**
**Supervised learning**
Regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVM, nearest-neighbor and probabilistic baselines.
  
  
**Unsupervised learning**
Clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection and segmentation validation.
  
  
**Time-dependent modeling**
Forecasting, temporal validation, lag and rolling features, seasonality and uncertainty.
  
  
**Data and features**
EDA, data-quality assessment, transformations, encoding, imbalance handling and leakage control.
  
  
**Evaluation**
Metric selection, baselines, validation design, statistical significance, calibration and business value.
  
  
**Production lifecycle**
Reproducibility, versioning, deployment, observability, drift, retraining and retirement.
  
  
**Governance**
Explainability, documentation, bias and fairness assessment, privacy, approvals and auditability.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  

* Meaningful global business problems and access to cross-functional expertise.
* Freedom to choose fit-for-purpose methods and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* A collaborative environment focused on engineering quality, responsible AI and measurable value.
* Opportunities to mentor, build reusable capabilities and shape the enterprise AI practice.

At Global IT Hub, we believe exceptional talent drives exceptional transformation. As a strategic partner for next-generation digital transformation, we empower our people to innovate boldly, collaborate globally, and turn ideas into solutions that create lasting business value. Join a team where learning never stops, innovation is part of our DNA, and your contribution helps shape the future of a global industry leader.
  
  
Role Evolution – Next 3–4 Years
  
  

* Evolve from predictive modelling toward decision intelligence, combining prediction, causal analysis, simulation and optimization.
* Build hybrid AI solutions integrating classical ML with Generative AI, foundation models and AI agents.
* Establish systematic benchmarking across classical ML, deep learning and emerging AI models to select the best approach based on performance, explainability, scalability and cost.
* Drive automation of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and model retirement.
* Develop advanced model evaluation frameworks covering technical performance, business impact, robustness, explainability, fairness and operational reliability.
* Advance model observability and continuous learning, proactively managing data drift, concept drift and model degradation.
* Strengthen Responsible AI and model governance, including lineage, reproducibility, explainability, bias assessment, human oversight and auditability.
* Develop reusable ML frameworks, components and engineering standards to accelerate enterprise-wide AI development.

title: Senior Scientist, Modeling & Simulation
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Scientist, Modeling & Simulation
  
  
**Job Description:**
**The Role:**
As the semiconductor technologies advance, the roles of new materials are becoming crucial in the technology development. We intend to establish the atomistic modeling and simulation capability (especially the molecular dynamics) to help us:
  
  
  

* Understand the chemical reactions and material properties under nano scale, which is becoming more and more challenging and expensive to achieve with conventional approaches.
* Design, evaluate and screen new materials or chemical formulations applied in diversified semiconductor processes expeditiously to shorten the overall new product development cycle time.

**In this role you will:**

* Work with different RD staffs, technologists, FAE etc. within Entegris or external customers/users to define problems and translate them into practical modeling and simulation projects.
* Establish atomistic models and simulations (molecular dynamics, DFT, etc.) efficiently combining different tools.
* Calculate and conclude important parameters or properties of a material system based on problem statements to help project stakeholders gain new insights with which they can expedite the technology/product development processes.
* Internalize and standardize derivative IPs (backgrounds & scenarios, models, parameters, codes, procedures, formula, calculations, etc.) of every project systematically to facilitate the re-use of such outcomes in other similar systems efficiently when necessary.

**Traits we believe make a strong candidate:**

* Good communication skills in both Mandarin and English
* A team player able to work with different stakeholders in diversified task forces.
* Basic understanding of semiconductor processes
* Academic backgrounds or experiences in atomistic modeling and simulation (especially in molecular dynamics) in chemical systems, material design or related areas.
* Proficiency in establishing atomistic models and simulations with commercial software or open-source software effectively and efficiently.
* Programming with Python, C++, Perl, MySQL etc. to extract, re-organize and calculate raw data from derivative databases.
* Ability to do research independently to identify best atomistic modeling and simulation approaches for targeted problems.

**Your success will be measured by:**

* Ability to work with stakeholders in diversified task forces smoothly.
* Ability to probe stakeholders’ needs and convert them into practical atomistic modeling and simulation projects.
* Discipline to deliver high quality modeling and simulation results in a timely manner.
* Dedication to improving modeling and simulation results continually by polishing the models/calibrating the directions based on stakeholders’ feedbacks and needs.
* A growth mindset to accept coaching and learn new knowledge to improve and grow himself/herself continually.
* Creativity to explore new modeling and simulation approaches to attack difficult problems.
* Innovative ideas to expand the applications of atomistic modeling and simulations in the corporate.
